decomposition_rationale: Evaluative engagement follows the classic M&A research DAG: (1) Market mapping and end-market assessment (independent), (2) Target screening depends on market mapping, (3) Financial analysis depends on target screening, (4) Synergy assessment depends on financial analysis. The DAG enforces that screening cannot begin until the market landscape is understood, and financial analysis cannot begin until targets are identified.

tasks.description: Map the specialty chemicals landscape by end market (EV batteries, semiconductors, advanced composites, coatings, adhesives) with market size, growth rate, fragmentation level, and margin profile per segment
acceptance_criteria: Market size and growth rate for 5+ specialty chemical end markets
Fragmentation assessment (top 5 share, HHI) per segment
Margin profile comparison across segments
Identification of segments with consolidation dynamics
tasks.anti_confirmatory_framing: Evaluate the attractiveness of each specialty chemical end market including evidence for both secular growth narratives and cyclical/structural risks that could undermine growth assumptions
tasks.end_product: End market comparison table (size, growth, fragmentation, margins), market attractiveness scoring matrix, growth-risk quadrant chart

tasks.description: Analyze M&A valuation multiples for specialty chemical transactions over the past 3 years: EV/EBITDA, EV/Revenue by sub-sector, deal size, buyer type (strategic vs financial)
acceptance_criteria: Transaction database with 20+ recent specialty chemical deals
Valuation multiple analysis by sub-sector and buyer type
Premium analysis for platform vs bolt-on acquisitions
Comparison to historical ranges (5-year and 10-year)
tasks.anti_confirmatory_framing: Evaluate M&A valuations including evidence for both the view that current multiples are justified by growth prospects and the view that the market is overheated with limited margin of safety for financial sponsors
tasks.end_product: M&A transaction comp table (20+ deals), valuation multiple box plots by sub-sector, historical multiple trend chart, platform vs bolt-on premium analysis

tasks.description: Assess regulatory landscape for specialty chemicals: REACH, TSCA, environmental liability exposure, and how regulatory complexity creates barriers to entry or M&A risk
acceptance_criteria: Key regulatory frameworks mapped by geography (US, EU, China)
Environmental liability assessment framework for M&A targets
Regulatory barrier-to-entry assessment per sub-sector
Recent enforcement actions or regulatory trends affecting the sector
tasks.anti_confirmatory_framing: Evaluate regulatory dynamics including evidence for regulations being both a moat (barriers to entry for new competitors) and a risk (compliance costs, liability exposure, potential product bans)
tasks.end_product: Regulatory framework comparison table (US/EU/China), liability risk scorecard by chemical type, regulatory moat assessment matrix

tasks.description: Screen the initial universe of 25+ specialty chemical companies against explicit criteria: revenue range ($50-300M), end-market alignment (EV, semi, composites), EBITDA margin profile, customer concentration, ownership (PE-friendly), and growth trajectory
acceptance_criteria: Screening criteria explicitly defined with pass/fail thresholds
All 25+ candidates evaluated against each criterion
Shortlist of 8-12 companies that pass initial screening
Rationale for inclusion/exclusion of borderline candidates
tasks.anti_confirmatory_framing: Apply screening criteria rigorously including evidence for companies that narrowly miss criteria but may warrant inclusion due to strategic value, and companies that pass all screens but carry hidden risks (customer concentration, IP exposure, environmental liability)
tasks.end_product: Screening matrix (25+ companies x criteria), shortlist of 8-12 with inclusion rationale, borderline case analysis

tasks.description: Conduct preliminary financial analysis on the 8-12 shortlisted targets: revenue trends, margin profile, capital intensity, working capital dynamics, and implied valuation at market multiples
acceptance_criteria: Financial summary for each shortlisted target
Revenue CAGR, EBITDA margin, capex/revenue ratio for each
Implied valuation range at observed sector multiples
Identification of financial red flags or standout metrics
tasks.anti_confirmatory_framing: Evaluate financial profiles including evidence for both attractive financial characteristics and concerning trends (margin compression, working capital deterioration, one-time items inflating metrics)
tasks.end_product: Financial comparison table (12 targets x key metrics), valuation range analysis, financial red flag summary

tasks.description: Assess competitive moats for shortlisted targets: customer switching costs, technical IP, regulatory certifications, scale advantages, and proprietary formulation barriers
acceptance_criteria: Moat assessment for each shortlisted target across 5 dimensions
Customer switching cost analysis with evidence
IP/patent landscape per target
Durability assessment for each moat dimension
tasks.anti_confirmatory_framing: Evaluate competitive moats including evidence for both durable moats (high switching costs, irreplaceable formulations) and vulnerable positions (commoditization risk, customer concentration, patent expiration)
tasks.end_product: Moat assessment matrix (targets x 5 moat dimensions), switching cost scorecard, moat durability ranking

tasks.description: Estimate synergy opportunities for top 5-8 targets: revenue synergies (cross-selling, geographic expansion), cost synergies (procurement, manufacturing, SG&A), and realistic capture timeline
acceptance_criteria: Revenue and cost synergy estimates for top targets
Synergy capture timeline (Year 1, Year 2, Year 3 run-rate)
Benchmarking against actual synergy capture in comparable chemical roll-ups
Identification of dis-synergy risks
tasks.anti_confirmatory_framing: Evaluate synergy potential including evidence for both achievable synergies (proven in comparable deals) and synergy overestimation risks (integration complexity, cultural mismatch, customer attrition during transition)
tasks.end_product: Synergy waterfall chart per target, capture timeline table, synergy benchmarking vs comparable deals, dis-synergy risk register

tasks.description: Produce final target ranking: composite score integrating financial attractiveness, strategic fit, competitive moat durability, synergy potential, and acquisition risk. Recommend final shortlist of 5-8 targets.
acceptance_criteria: Multi-factor composite scoring model with explicit weights
Final ranked shortlist of 5-8 targets
Investment thesis summary for each shortlisted target
Key risk factors and mitigants per target
tasks.anti_confirmatory_framing: Evaluate the final ranking including stress tests on weighting assumptions and evidence for why the top-ranked targets might be inferior choices to lower-ranked alternatives under different strategic assumptions
tasks.end_product: Final composite ranking table, per-target investment thesis (1-pager), risk/mitigant matrix, sensitivity to weight changes
